selected_pe.inspection: Read-only PE32 literal extraction with tools/generate_source_command_list_tables.py::read_pe_va; executable not run

ui_bmp_prefix.evidence: The PE literal bytes decode to an encoded UserInterface\ prefix followed by \\basic_interface\ filenames; Ref/MsgStrings.cpp UIBmp documents the skin/language/service resolution behavior.
ui_bmp_prefix.runtime_assumption: UIBmp first tries the active skin override when a game skin is active. Otherwise ServiceKorea uses the literal unchanged; other services try CLanguage::LanguageFile, then the UserInterface\ path fallback if present, else retain the literal. Do not hard-code the selected HighPriest executable's byte-encoded prefix as a path key. The non-Brazil/Brazil service branch in OnDraw affects only the title caption, not these bitmap literals.
ui_bmp_prefix.implementation_key_form: Filename-only basic_interface keys resolved by the current native/Qt UI asset resolver, e.g. ResolveUiAssetPath("itemwin_left.bmp").

source.coordinates: Window-local client coordinates; bitmap calls use DrawBitmap(..., flag 0) unless otherwise specified.

titlebar.notes: Middle stride is hard-coded to 12 px. Loop count is max(0, ceil((w-24)/12)); source does not derive stride from loaded bitmap width.

side_borders.notes: Both use a hard-coded 8 px vertical stride. Right edge uses each loaded bitmap's intrinsic width. Counts clamp to zero through the source's positive-count branch.

bottom_bar.notes: Middle stride is hard-coded to 21 px; loop count is max(0, ceil((w-42)/21)). Left and middle use their own loaded heights, while right y is explicitly h-21.

interior_fill_and_edge.paint_order: Titlebar bitmaps; outer fill; inner fill; tiled itemwin sides; vertical inset rule; btnbar bottom; title text and list content.
interior_fill_and_edge.boundary_reading: Fill rectangles use source DrawBox x/y/width/height arguments, not right/bottom coordinates. The second fill is inset one pixel horizontally; it is not a second full-frame outline. Tab is independently positioned at (0,17) by OnCreate and occupies the left interior edge.

implementation_contract.asset_loading: Use LoadBitmapPixelsFromGameData(ResolveUiAssetPath(filename)) for all six bitmap keys; retain current service/skin aware path resolution. No separate command-list frame asset was found in source.
implementation_contract.tiling: Mirror source loops with integer ceiling division and the stated fixed strides/origins. For each count, draw only when count>0. Align right segments by loaded bitmap width and bottom left/middle by loaded bitmap height as stated.
implementation_contract.fill: Preserve the two nested skin-chip fills and the x=18 one-pixel rule in order. Skin chip colors are runtime-dependent; the source passes their green/blue packed channels to DrawBox.
implementation_contract.caption_service_branch: g_serviceType == ServiceBrazil selects Lista de Comandos; all other service types select Command List. Both TextOutWithShadow calls are at (17,2), white (0xFFFFFF), font 0, height 12.
implementation_contract.caveat: This is a source/selected-PE contract only. It does not assert exact final raster clipping/blending or resolve asset-file intrinsic dimensions; those remain properties of the live resource files and DrawBitmap backend.
